purpose.zh: 练侧腰，让上身转得有劲
purpose.en: Builds the sides of your waist so you can twist with strength.

text.zh: 上身往后靠、背挺直，胸口慢慢转向一边
text.en: Lean back with a long back and slowly turn your chest to one side

text.zh: 膝盖和屁股朝前不动，脚后跟踩地。
text.en: Knees and hips face forward, heels on the floor.
Come back to the middle, then turn the other way.

text.zh: 转到左边、再转到右边，合起来记 1 下。
text.en: Turning to the left and then to the right is one.

commonErrors.en: Swinging your arms without turning your chest.

cautions.zh: 腰发紧就脚踩地做，转小一点
cautions.en: If your lower back tightens, keep your feet down and twist less.
